ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached diagram shows triangle PSQ with P, R, and S lying on the same straight base line, with R between P and S. Point Q is above the base, and segments PQ, QR, and QS are drawn. The angle at P between PQ and PS is marked 20°, and the unknown angle is at Q between QR and QS, namely ∠RQS. Reasoning: Since R lies on PS, the angle ∠QPR is the same as ∠QPS, so ∠QPR = 20°. From PQ = PR, triangle PQR is isosceles, so its base angles are equal: ∠PQR = ∠QRP = (180° - 20°)/2 = 80°. Also, from PQ = QS, triangle PQS is isosceles with base PS, so ∠QPS = ∠PSQ = 20°. Therefore ∠PQS = 180° - 20° - 20° = 140°. The segment QR splits ∠PQS into ∠PQR and ∠RQS, so ∠RQS = 140° - 80° = 60°.

method.method_draft: Use a coordinate/trigonometric placement. From the image, place P, R, S on the x-axis with R between P and S, and Q above the base; the 20° at P is the angle that PQ makes with the positive x-axis. From the text, scale the common length PQ = PR = QS to 1. Set P = (0,0), R = (1,0), and Q = (cos 20°, sin 20°). Since QS = 1 and S lies to the right on the x-axis, S = (2 cos 20°, 0). Then the direction of QS from Q is at angle -20° to the x-axis. The vector QR = (1 - cos 20°, -sin 20°) has direction -80° because 1 - cos 20° = 2 sin²10° and sin 20° = 2 sin10° cos10°. Therefore the angle between QR and QS is |-20° - (-80°)| = 60°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中三角形 PSQ 的底边 PS 是一条水平线，点 R 在 P 与 S 之间；点 Q 在底边上方。线段 QR 把三角形 PSQ 分成两个小三角形。图中在 P 处标出角 QPS 为 20°，要求的是 Q 点处线段 QR 与 QS 之间的角 RQS。

推理：按坐标/三角方法放置图形。由图可取 P、R、S 在 x 轴上，R 在 P 和 S 之间，Q 在上方。令公共长度 PQ = PR = QS = 1。设 P = (0,0)，R = (1,0)。因为 ∠QPS = 20°，且 PQ = 1，所以 Q = (cos20°, sin20°)。又 QS = 1，且 S 在 x 轴右侧，故 S 是以 Q 为圆心、半径 1 的圆与 x 轴的右侧交点，即 S = (2cos20°, 0)。因此从 Q 指向 S 的向量为 QS = (cos20°, -sin20°)，方向角为 -20°。从 Q 指向 R 的向量为 QR = (1 - cos20°, -sin20°)。利用 1 - cos20° = 2sin²10°，sin20° = 2sin10°cos10°，可得 QR 的斜率方向满足 tan θ = -sin20°/(1 - cos20°) = -cot10°，所以 QR 的方向角为 -80°。于是 ∠RQS 是方向角 -20° 与 -80° 的夹角，大小为 60°。
